Exactly EIGHT sequential frames in a precise 4-column by 2-row regular grid, read left-to-right across the first row then the second. Each cell is a square with exactly the same dimensions. Use a landscape 2:1 canvas. Each frame contains exactly one complete round robot head centered at the same coordinates within its cell. The head occupies exactly 76 percent of each cell's width and height, with ample black clearance. All eight heads have the SAME overall width, same crown height, same light, same design, fixed camera and fixed scale. NO text, NO frame numbers, NO grid lines, NO gray circular display borders, NO decorative marks. Pure solid black background across the entire sheet.

Identity: the exact broad round warm-ivory open-skeleton robot in the reference, with no neck, open orbital rims, REALISTIC GRAY-GREEN IRIS EYES and flesh-toned mechanical lids, a short ivory nose, shallow curved forehead, floating cheeks, exposed brass/silver/dark metal skeleton, two rows of ivory mechanical teeth and rounded U-shaped chin cradle. Preserve its adult wry personality. All ivory and metal parts retain their form and position between frames except explicitly moving hinge joints. No morphing, material changes, extra teeth, new features, arbitrary expression shifts, human skin covering, cartoon eyes or props. High-quality photoreal rendering with soft studio illumination. The image will be sliced into frames and PLAYED AS A LOOP: neighboring frames must differ only by a tiny controlled movement, not redesign. Keep cheeks, skull and metal construction identical pixel-for-pixel as far as possible.
